title: Coast in The API Economy: Making APIs Impossible to Ignore
summary: Aug 13, 2025. Discover how Coast turns complex APIs into interactive, on-brand demos that win over every stakeholder. Featured in The API Economy with Zurich Insurance, FIS, and Galileo.
body_markdown: Peter Schroeder’s latest edition of *The API Economy* spotlights Coast’s role in transforming how companies showcase APIs. Featuring Zurich Insurance, FIS, Galileo, and more, the article shows how Coast’s interactive demos bridge the gap between technical capability and business value, helping teams move faster, win more deals, and align around a shared vision.
